item.title: How a Russian ship under sanctions delivered armoured vehicles to Mali
item.summary: Dozens of military vehicles transported from Russia were delivered to Mali through the port of Conakry, Guinea, in late March. The equipment was carried by a Russian cargo ship currently under international sanctions.

item.title: Nigerian airstrike hits market in northeast Yobe state
item.summary: At least 200 people are feared dead after Nigerian military jets struck a village market while ​pursuing Islamist ‌militants in the northeast of the country on Saturday night, a councillor for ⁠the area and residents said on Sunday.

item.title: Vance says progress made with Iran as sides weigh second round of talks
item.summary: The United States ​made a ‌lot of ⁠progress in talks with ‌Iran, US Vice President ⁠JD Vance said in an interview on ​Fox Newson Monday, saying the ball was in Iran's court when it came to whether a second round of talks would take place.

item.title: Rubio hosts Israeli, Lebanese envoys as talks begin in Washington
item.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio hosted the Lebanese and Israeli ambassadors in Washington on Tuesday for the first direct peace talks between the countries in decades. France 24’s Kethevane Gorjestani takes a look at the talks’ significance, at what they might yield.
